MUS.name: Mauritius

SEA.name: International Shipping (on board ships worldwide)
visa: Seafarer documents: CDC (Continuous Discharge Certificate), INDoS, STCW courses, C1/D visa as needed
general: Shipping company career pages (Maersk, MSC, Anglo-Eastern, Synergy, Fleet Management, BSM, Wallem)
DG Shipping-licensed RPSL manning agencies only (dgshipping.gov.in list)
SEA.note: Check the RPSL licence on the DG Shipping website – fake shipping agents are common.

CRU.name: Cruise Ships
visa: C1/D seafarer visa (US), STCW basic safety
general: Royal Caribbean, Carnival, MSC Cruises, Norwegian Cruise Line career sites
Their authorised Indian hiring partners only
CRU.note: Contracts of 6–9 months; tips + salary; check agent authorisation directly with the cruise line.

orderHelp: Countries are ranked by how many jobs are open to Indians, how easy entry is, and pay. This is a guide, not an official ranking.
safety: Use only MEA-registered recruiting agents (check on emigrate.gov.in) or govt agencies like TOMCOM (Telangana) and NSDC International.
Never pay money for a 'job visa'. Gulf/UK/Ireland employers normally pay visa costs.
Get the job offer/contract in writing, check the company online, and keep copies with family.
